Demo University of Health Sciences
Convocation Notification

The Twelfth Annual Convocation of the University will be held on
2025-06-14. Candidates who have qualified for the award of degrees,
diplomas and medals during the academic year 2024-25 are required to
register online before the notified date.

Degrees are awarded on the basis of cumulative grade point average
recorded at the end of the final semester.
